patch_description:
The worst_group_margin is the bottleneck (0.34), indicating the circuit struggles with hard samples. Current approach uses only fixed CZ gates for entanglement.

Proposal: Replace some of the longer-distance CZ gates with parametrized XX gates to increase expressiveness for complex separations. Use aggressive parameter sharing (1-2 new params for all these gates) to maintain efficiency.

This trades a small increase in parameter count (9→11 distinct params) for significantly better worst-case margin on difficult samples. The XX Ising gates can capture non-linear patterns that pure RZ rotations and fixed CZ interactions cannot.
